meaning: A new capability for users of the code or product
example: feat(cart): let shoppers save items for later

meaning: A bug fix: behaviour now matches what was intended
example: fix(auth): keep users signed in after a token refresh

meaning: A change that makes something measurably faster or lighter without changing behaviour
example: perf(list): virtualize rows to cut render time on long feeds

meaning: Code restructuring with no change in behaviour
example: refactor(api): extract retry logic into a shared helper
docs(readme): explain the recommended and full install commands

meaning: Formatting and whitespace only; no logic change
example: style: apply prettier to the components folder
ci: run the installer smoke test on Windows

meaning: Maintenance that touches neither source nor tests

example: revert: feat(cart): let shoppers save items for later

meaning: A fix for a vulnerability (use only if the repo's convention allows this type)
example: security(auth): reject open redirects in the login callback

meaning: Marks something for removal later (use only if the repo's convention allows this type)
example: deprecate(api): mark v1 search endpoint as deprecated

meaning: Not a type: add ! after the type or scope or a BREAKING CHANGE footer to any type
example: feat(api)!: require an API key on every request
